goal: Webhook Signature Security, Rate Limiter & Event Deduplication Middleware
context: Protect webhooks and widget ingestion against replay attacks, duplicate delivery spikes, and flood attempts from malicious or unstable external network retries.
requirements: Build LRU event deduplication cache backed by SQLite activity logs
Implement token-bucket rate limiter per IP / workspace
Enforce HMAC-SHA256 signature verification helper for Meta and Zalo payloads
Wrap HTTP handler endpoints in ai_inbox/api/server.py cleanly
acceptance_criteria: Deduplicates duplicate webhook message IDs within 10-minute window, blocks flood rate limit violations with 429 Too Many Requests
